The roots of the problem like with gold mining; since the California Gold Rush, mercury used for in gold extraction.  Historically, 10-30% of mercury was lost in the mining process, resulting in widespread contamination of river and lake sediments.  Many water bodies in the state of California bear fish consumption advisories due to mercury content.
